body.statement: Fix \(L\). Every decomposition \(z=m+\beta\) with \(m\in L\), \(\|m\|_2\le A\), \(\|\beta\|_0\le s\), and \(\|\beta\|_\infty\le B\) has a unique labeled effect vector \(\beta\) if and only if \(\kappa_s(L)>0\). If \(\kappa_s(L)=0\), two distinct admissible vectors generate the same complete observed-data law with constant post factors.
body.justification: This is the exact identification boundary that makes the margin-indexed inference problem meaningful.
body.gap: ChandrasekaranEtAl2011 and FickusMixon2013 contain the generic sparse-subspace geometry; the causal contribution starts after this supporting equivalence.
body.consumer: It tells applied users when a full labeled direct-and-spillover vector is distinguishable without selecting valid donors.
